wip.summary: A Forest Labyrinth deep beneath a towering canopy, down in the darkwoods, Puzzles, Traps and more

features.label: Watch your step, any tile could be fatal
Something's not right with this part of the forest

maps.name: Webwood
maps.description:
A dense, ancient forest choked with thick, unyielding spider silk. Navigating these darkened woods means cutting through sticky traps and obscured paths, all while avoiding the gaze of the massive arachnids that hunt from the canopy above.

GM Hooks

• The Captive: Someone's still alive up in the silk, and running out of time.
• The Harvest: Venom and webbing here are worth a small fortune, if you can collect it without waking anything up.
• The Broodmother: She's still out there, and the wood is only getting more hers by the day.

Tread lightly. Every vibration on the webbing draws them closer, and they're always listening.

maps.name: War Camp
maps.description:
The War Camp is more than just a collection of tents. It's the staging ground for a force that doesn't believe in mercy. I wanted this map to feel heavy and dangerous, with the massive command tent acting as the "HQ" where the Ravagers plot their next strike.

GM Hooks

• The Assassination: The war-leader is only vulnerable tonight, and only for a few hours.
• The Sabotage: Wreck the forge before dawn, and the next raid never happens.
• The Infiltration: Someone needs to get inside the ranks and find out where they're striking next.

Plenty of tactical space here for things to go sideways fast.

maps.name: The Sacre Mal
maps.description:
A cathedral of fractured marble and rhythmic decay, where the pious and the putrid gather to witness the ultimate sacrifice. The Grand Prelate is always looking for fresh converts, and he's rarely picky about how willing they are.

GM Hooks

• The Infiltration: The liturgy hides exactly what's being sacrificed, and who's next.
• The Convert: Kneeling in the pews as a reluctant convert buys time, but not much of it.
• The Altar: The ritual is nearly complete. Stopping it means reaching the altar first.

Survive the liturgy, and you might just leave with your spirit intact.

maps.name: Crimson Lounge
maps.description:
Welcome to the Crimson Lounge, the city's most exclusive subterranean crypt. Dim lights, vintages, and zero sunlight. It's the bougiest spot for your players to meet a contact (or become the main course).

GM Hooks

• The Introduction: A fixer wants to vet the party before handing over a job, but everyone in the room is armed and watching.
• The Wrong Table: The party accidentally sits at a seat reserved for a vampire lord's guest. How they talk their way out matters more than their swords.
• Last Call: Sunrise is close and the Lounge's true nature is about to show. Can the party leave before the doors seal?

Order the wine, mind your neck, and enjoy the ambience while it lasts.

maps.name: The Red Hand
maps.description:
"So, you heard about the Red Hand? Look, it ain't pretty. Don't expect comfort, expect cheap ale and shifty eyes... But if you're desperate, or just plain mad, that noticeboard outside is usually crawling with the kind of work the good folk pretend doesn't exist."

GM Hooks

• The Trinket: "Retrieve this cursed trinket." Nobody's specified from where, or from whom.
• The Cult: "Silence that noisy cult." Quietly, if possible. Preferably before the neighbors notice.
• The Escort: "Escort a very important, very dead cargo." No further questions, please.

Just don't get yourself etched onto one of the 'missing' posters, and for the love of the gods, never ask about the name.

maps.name: Solar Keep
maps.description:
Perched high where the sky meets the stone, Solar Keep is a majestic fortification built to harness and defend the power of the sun. Its gleaming marble halls and open-air battlements catch the light at every hour, day or night.

GM Hooks

• The Ritual: A celestial rite atop the highest tower needs protecting until it's complete.
• The Siege: Every wall here was built for exactly this moment, and it's about to be tested.
• The Radiant Foe: Something that shouldn't be able to stand in this much light is standing in it anyway.

It has never once gone dark.

maps.name: Scarecrows Watch
maps.description:
The village came together to build a guardian, one large enough to scare off all who would ruin their crops. Years passed, and some say the guardian took on a mind of its own, scaring away even those who built it. Now only the faithful remain, treating it like some dark god.

GM Hooks

• The Silence: Nobody's heard from the village in weeks, and the last messenger never came back.
• The Guardian: Whatever the scarecrow has become, it's no longer just scaring off crows.
• The Tribute: The faithful are preparing another offering, and it isn't grain this time.

These fields don't feel like they belong to the living anymore.

maps.name: Necropolis
maps.description:
A small, atmospheric graveyard designed to bring a sense of history and unease to your game. I wanted this map to feel old and overgrown, where the narrow paths between headstones and the shadows of the monuments make every step feel a bit heavier.

GM Hooks

• The Disturbed Grave: Someone, or something, has already been digging here tonight.
• The Awakening: Whatever wasn't supposed to be moving has noticed the party first.
• The Vigil: A family has hired the party to guard a burial the dead don't seem to want left alone.

The dead here are resting... or not.

maps.name: Hunters Guild Hall
maps.description:
A bastion for those who make their living in the shadows of the world's most dangerous predators. This isn't a place of luxury, but of necessity: a reinforced lodge where the air smells of pine resin, whetstones, and dried trophies.

Legends say the guild was founded on the site of a legendary beast's fall, and its foundations are anchored by the very weapons used to slay it.

GM Hooks

• The Bounty: A job's been sitting on the board too long. Nobody's come back from the last three attempts.
• The Trial: Membership isn't handed out. It's earned, in front of witnesses who won't go easy.
• The Founding Beast: A rumor persists that the beast this hall was built to honor never actually died.

Show up empty-handed and you won't be welcome twice.

maps.name: Deathdome
maps.description:
If you've got a spare bone coin, I've heard of a fight you should bet. Just don't end up in that arena yourself. There's a champion you haven't yet met.

Deathdome is a place of raw entertainment for the living and undead alike, where the crowd roars just as loud for a killing blow as they do for a clean one.

GM Hooks

• The Wager: A rigged fight is coming up, and someone's paying well to know the outcome in advance.
• The Challenger: One of the party has been drafted into the next bout, willing or not.
• The Patron's Favor: The House's patron is watching tonight. Impress him, and he remembers names.

The House always collects, one way or another.

maps.name: Carrion Carnival
maps.description:
Step right up! If you've got the SPINE for it!

The Carrion Carnival is officially open for business. Come for the world-famous Big Top, stay because the Ringmaster has literally stolen your soul! Admission is free, but leaving will cost you an arm and a leg. Literally.

GM Hooks

• The Vanishing Act: Performers keep disappearing between shows, and the crowd hasn't noticed, or doesn't care.
• The Main Event: Someone the party loves is booked in the ring tonight. Winning is the only way out.
• Behind the Curtain: The Ringmaster's tent is off-limits to everyone. That's usually where the answers are.

Step right up. Everybody's welcome. Nobody leaves the same.

maps.name: Battlebridge
maps.description:
This jagged span of wood and stone turns every crossing into a desperate fight for survival. More than just a path, it is a blood-stained choke point where narrow walkways and crumbling cover force players to think fast or be shoved into the abyss below.

GM Hooks

• The Last Stand: The party is all that's holding the bridge against a horde already crossing.
• The Ambush: A caravan mid-crossing makes an easy target, right up until the party realizes they're not the only ones with that idea.
• The Duel: Honor, a grudge, or a bounty: someone wants this settled at the exact center, where neither side can retreat.

One wrong step and the abyss makes the decision for you.

maps.name: Amphail Mountain Town
maps.description:
Amphail wasn't built for comfort; it was built to be a bottleneck. Wedged into a narrow rocky valley with sheer cliffs on either side, this fort-town is the only way through to the sacred grounds further up the mountain, and every soul who passes through knows it.

GM Hooks

• The Checkpoint: The party is manning the gate when a caravan arrives with papers that don't quite add up.
• The Siege: Something is massing beyond the cliffs, and the wardens are one bad night from being overrun.
• The Parley: A local warden wants a private word with the party: no blades, no wagons, just talk.

Choose your ground carefully; there's nowhere else to go.

maps.name: Flubs Ferry
maps.description:
Ferry man: "Aye, but not for the souls of the dead, at least, not always. Ain't no river Styx, this is just a big ol' pond, and if ye wanna get across ye definitely be paying tolls to this ferry man.

Don't stare into the water for too long, it uh, plays tricks with ye, you'll get ye sea legs, laddy."

GM Hooks

• The Crossing: Honest passage, honest toll, so long as nobody asks what's really in the cargo hold.
• The Runaway: Someone's paying the ferryman extra to not remember who boarded tonight.
• The Wake: Something's been trailing the ferry beneath the surface, and it's getting closer to the boat.

Now find a seat, laddy. He's got captain'y things to be about.

maps.name: Mystic Camp
maps.description:
A glowing sanctuary and a mysterious crossroads for those trekking through the deep woods. The camp is a gathering of ornate wagons and weathered rugs surrounding a central ritual circle that hums with a faint, rhythmic magic.

They say the wagons are filled with more than just silk and spices.

GM Hooks

• The Trade: Something rare changes hands here, if the price and the buyer are both right.
• The Reading: The circle offers a glimpse of what's ahead, for those willing to hear the answer.
• The Cargo: One of the wagons is guarded a little too closely for something that's supposedly just silk.

Nobody here asks where you're headed next, so don't ask them either.

maps.name: Thieves Guild (Free)
maps.description: Enter the Den of the Night Owl, Bootless Benny, The thieves guild is a tighly packed map & adventure

maps.name: Red Dragon Keep
maps.description:
Legend tells of a great redwood forest, far from here, where you might seek the Red Dragon and his followers. Or is it just a legend? Perhaps this is just another old military keep, paying homage to a forgotten time.

GM Hooks

• The Legend: Someone's put together enough clues to believe the Red Dragon is real, and close.
• The Salvage: Whatever the old garrison left behind is still down there, untouched.
• The Truth: Something in these halls is very much alive, and it isn't a dragon.

Old stone remembers more than it lets on.

maps.name: Sewer Rats Refuge
maps.description:
"Down where the bricks weep, he holds his court. That ain't just a crown on his head, it's a cursed artifact, and it gave the beast that wears it a wicked, human cunning. His kingdom is built on stolen goods and lost things. Now his swarming subjects are getting bolder, and their chittering sounds like dark prayers. He doesn't just want our scraps anymore; he wants the whole town."

GM Hooks

• The Hoard: Something valuable was taken down into the tunnels, and its owner wants it back.
• The Crown: Ending his reign means taking the crown, and surviving what it does to whoever wears it next.
• The Swarm: The tunnels are getting louder. Getting back out may matter more than what the party came down for.

Someone has to go down and break his crown. Might as well be you.

maps.name: Weeping Woods
maps.description:
In the Dark Wood stands a tree older than time itself. Much like a spring produces water, the Weeping Ash produces a green nectar drawn deep from the earth, filtered through its roots, and wept from its trunk. Some say the nectar cures nearly anything.

GM Hooks

• The Glade: A client is out of time, and out of options besides this tree.
• The Harvest: Taking the nectar is possible. Taking it without consequence is a different question.
• The Locals: The people guarding this place don't trust outsiders, and they have good reason not to.

Not many know where the tree is hidden, and the locals would very much like to keep it that way.

maps.name: Artificers Workshop
maps.description:
If you need gear no one else can make, you brave the northern cliffs to see Torvin. His workshop is a multi-level marvel bolted right into the mountain face, filled with the hum of enchanted gears and the glow of crystal cores. He's a surly hermit, but his artificed weapons are the finest in the land.

GM Hooks

• The Commission: Torvin will build exactly what the party needs, for a price steeper than gold.
• The Repair: A relic critical to the party's plans is broken, and only Torvin's hands can fix it in time.
• The Blueprint: Someone's paying well for a look inside his vault of prototypes. Torvin has never once failed to notice a thief.

Bring a good bottle as a greeting. It's the only language he speaks besides gears.

maps.name: Royal Study
maps.description:
This is the King's private sanctuary. Here, with only his wolf for company, he searches his collection of forbidden texts for a cure to the Spreading Blight. He allows only his most trusted monastic scholars to study here, hoping their combined wisdom can find the secret that will save the world before it's too late.

GM Hooks

• The Breakthrough: The scholars are close to an answer, but they need something only the party can retrieve.
• The Theft: A forbidden text needs to disappear before the King realizes what it says.
• The Audience: A monarch who trusts almost no one left alive has agreed, reluctantly, to listen.

Time is the one thing nobody here can spare.

maps.name: Fleshworks
maps.description:
This is the Fleshworks, a grim parody of a factory where the production line deals in death. Here, the Master rejects stone and clay, using lightning and alchemy to stitch life into his golems. Chains hoist components to the assembly table, where the city's missing are grimly repurposed.

His quota isn't for mindless laborers. It's for the perfect being: a child forged from stolen parts.

GM Hooks

• The Missing: A loved one's trail leads straight through the front gate.
• The Sabotage: The next shipment leaves at dawn. Stopping the line means stopping it before then.
• The Master: His masterpiece is nearly finished. What the party does about that can't be undone.

The chains keep moving either way.

maps.name: Devils Bargain
maps.description:
Rumors of a shop exist. A shop with the best deals, a shop with the best stock, tucked somewhere it shouldn't be. The catch? It doesn't take gold. Only the devil behind the counter knows the price, and he never quotes it twice.

GM Hooks

• The Tip: A desperate stranger swears the shop is real, and swears they know how to find it.
• The Price: The item the party needs is here, but the cost isn't measured in coin.
• The Buyback: A deal was signed that shouldn't have been. Undoing it may cost more than making it did.

Everything in this shop is for sale, including sometimes the buyer. Read the fine print, if you can find it.

maps.name: Farmhouse
maps.description:
Just your classic creepy, abandoned homestead, right? Don't let the rotting floorboards fool you. Hidden beneath this muddy farmhouse and cluttered barn is a haunting stone dungeon packed with glowing arcane labs, tight corridors, and suspicious holding cells.

Let's just say whoever lived up top was into some seriously dark extracurriculars in the basement.

GM Hooks

• The Disappearances: A string of vanishings from a nearby town all trace back to this address.
• The Labs: Something down there is still glowing, and whoever built it left in a hurry.
• The Cells: There's still someone, or something, locked below. Whether that's a rescue or a mistake is up to the party.

Bring a lantern. The dark down there doesn't like visitors.

maps.name: Prison Camp
maps.description:
Caught between the relentless, deafening scream of the sawmill and the back-breaking stone quarry, the camp exists to grind both bone and spirit into dust. Here, you don't serve a sentence; you swing a pickaxe or haul timber until the mountain or the mill finally claims you.

GM Hooks

• The Breakout: A name is coming up on the wrong list, and there isn't much time left to act.
• The Sentence: The party themselves have been thrown in on a charge they didn't earn.
• The Infiltration: New guards are being brought in this week. Nobody's checking papers too closely yet.

The mountain always takes its due.

maps.name: The Riftwatch Monument
maps.description:
The Riftwatch Monument serves as a solemn vigil and a rugged sanctuary for weary travelers. The camp is a gathering of reinforced canvas and scavenged stone fortifications, humming faintly with the low vibration of the nearby anomaly: the Colossal Titan.

They say its head is filled with treasure. Maybe we can get inside its ear?

GM Hooks

• The Excavation: Something inside the Titan's skull is rattling loose, and it's worth a fortune to whoever gets there first.
• The Outpost: The anomaly is drawing closer, and the camp needs to hold if anyone's getting out.
• The Watchers: The ancient dwarven sentries are still standing guard, centuries after their orders should have expired.

Riftwatch has never stopped humming. Nobody's figured out why yet.

maps.name: Shadow Market
maps.description:
Keep your coin close and your shadow closer. The Shadow Market unfolds after dark in the dampest corners of the city, and it's never quite in the same place twice.

GM Hooks

• The Screams: A jar of bottled screams is for sale. Someone recognizes the voice.
• The Grave Map: A vendor is selling directions to a grave that, as far as anyone knows, hasn't been dug yet.
• The Trade: One of the party needs to lose something, a memory, a curse, a debt, and there's a vendor here who deals in exactly that.

Just don't ask where the "fresh" meat comes from. Some bargains are better left unexplained.
